summary: Technical product leader with 25 years in software, 20 of them hands-on as a full-stack engineer. Six years running accessibility governance and compliance programs at Pearson and Elsevier. Focused on technical product management for AI-native platforms in regulated environments.

points: Owned intake, backlog governance, and roadmap operations for the largest division, covering 40+ product teams.
Co-authored the global Definition of Done and established the KPI framework for defect escape and remediation velocity.
Led adoption of an AI-augmented documentation and testing platform, cutting documentation production time 50%.
Ran a nine-month remediation program across ten product teams that ended in a written withdrawal of a federal complaint.
Built a company-wide Figma annotation toolkit and design review workflow, with Axe and Cypress wired into CI/CD; defect escape rate fell 66% in three months.
Architected a component library in Angular, documented in Storybook, that became the engineering standard across all product lines.
Led compliance work for NYU, SUNY, and the University of Washington.

other: Independent advisory practice serving a dozen organizations.
Speaker, CSUN 2025: the ION Framework for evaluating AI chat interfaces.
education: B.S. in Business Administration and Information Technology, Colorado Technical University
